actions.desc: Teleports one object it is holding that weighs up to 10 pounds into empty hand of one friendly creature it can see within 30' of it. If target isn't a rochade it must make DC 14 Dex save to catch the object otherwise object falls to the ground in a space within 5 ft. of target.

actions.desc: When a creature rochade can see targets it with attack rochade can switch places with any creature it can see within 15 ft. of it. An unwilling creature must make DC 14 Dex save to avoid the switch. If the switch is successful switched creature becomes attack's target instead.
